description: This file contains utility functions for WebRTC session description parsing, ICE candidate parsing, and ICE server message generation, primarily used in WebRTC streaming within the Android Open Source Project.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Converts a vector of type T to a JSON array using a provided conversion function.

methods.name: ParseSessionDescription
methods.description: Parses a session description from a JSON message.

methods.name: ParseIceCandidate
methods.description: Parses an ICE candidate from a JSON message.

methods.name: ParseError
methods.description: Extracts an error string from a JSON message.

methods.name: ParseIceServersMessage
methods.description: Parses ICE server configurations from a JSON message.

methods.name: GenerateIceServersMessage
methods.description: Generates a JSON message from ICE server configurations.
